body.statement: For an ADMG \(\mathcal G\) on \(V\), the effect \(P(Y=y\mid\operatorname{do}(X=x))\) is not identifiable from \(P(V)\) if and only if \(\mathcal G\) contains a hedge for \(P(Y'=y'\mid\operatorname{do}(X'=x'))\) for some \(Y'\subseteq Y\) and \(X'\subseteq X\).

source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 19 (hedge criterion) P(v),G does not identify P(y|do(x)) if and only if G contains a hedge for some P(y′|do(x′)), where y′ ⊆ y, x′ ⊆ x.
